mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_incidents (id, type, endpoint, client_ip, actor, payload, action_taken, status, severity, score, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{endpoint}, #{clientIp}, #{actor}, #{payload}, #{actionTaken}, #{status}, #{severity}, #{score}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM security_incidents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM security_incidents WHERE created_at < datetime('now', '-' || #{days} || ' days')
